rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when something is clear and easy to understand.

example.jyutping: ne1 fan6 zi2 jan5 se2 dak1 hou2 ji6 ming4

rows.note: Use this when someone's action or situation is understandable and can be excused in context.

example.english: It is understandable that you could not come back for dinner because something came up.
example.traditional: 你臨時有事，唔返嚟食飯都可以理解。
example.jyutping: nei5 lam4 si4 jau5 si6 m4 faan1 lai4 sik6 faan6 dou1 ho2 ji5 lei5 gaai2
